dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each input X_i is assumed to satisfy this property with the supplied K_i, and the first conclusion, after dispatch through LocalDef003 at LocalDef004, gives the same property to S with K=sqrt(∑ K_i²). dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports the auxiliary expression 1+1 proving availability of the numeral 2 and has no substantive target effect.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous HAdd instance induced by ordinary addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes the auxiliary natural addition 1+1 to Nat.add and adds no mathematical clause.

binders: An arbitrary type ι equipped with a Fintype structure; no Nonempty or Inhabited assumption is present, so ι may syntactically be empty.
An arbitrary measurable space Ω and a measure μ on Ω equipped with the assertion that μ is a probability measure.
A finite family X=(X_i)_{i∈ι} of real-valued functions X_i:Ω→ℝ.
A family of real parameters K=(K_i)_{i∈ι}.
After all data and hypotheses, an existentially quantified real C witnessing all final conjuncts; its scope permits dependence on the entire fixed instance.
hypotheses: For every i∈ι, SubGaussianLinearMGF μ X_i K_i holds: X_i is Borel measurable, K_i>0, X_i is μ-integrable, ∫X_i dμ=0, and for every λ∈ℝ the function exp(λX_i) is μ-integrable and ∫exp(λX_i)dμ≤exp(K_i²λ²).
The indexed family (X_i)_{i∈ι} is jointly independent with respect to μ.
The energy E:=∑_{i∈ι}K_i² is strictly positive: 0<E. This is an explicit strict side condition, not merely E≥0.
conclusions: There exists a real C with 1≤C.

Writing S(ω):=∑_{i∈ι}X_i(ω) and E:=∑_{i∈ι}K_i², SubGaussianProperty μ S .linearMGF sqrt(E) holds. Because .linearMGF dispatches exactly to SubGaussianLinearMGF, this says S is measurable, sqrt(E)>0, S is integrable and centered, and for every λ∈ℝ, exp(λS) is integrable with ∫exp(λS)dμ≤exp(Eλ²).
For the same witness C, PsiTwoGauge μ S≤ENNReal.ofReal(C sqrt(E)), where PsiTwoGauge is the ENNReal infimum of finite nonzero t for which exp(S²/(t.toReal)²) is integrable and has integral at most 2.
mathematical_definitions: S:Ω→ℝ is the pointwise finite sum S(ω)=∑_{i∈ι}X_i(ω).
E∈ℝ is the finite sum of natural squares E=∑_{i∈ι}K_i².
SubGaussianLinearMGF μ Y L means: Y is measurable; L>0; Y is integrable and centered; and for every real λ, exp(λY) is integrable and E_μ[exp(λY)]≤exp(L²λ²).
SubGaussianProperty μ Y .linearMGF L is definitionally the same predicate as SubGaussianLinearMGF μ Y L; the property-form tag does not weaken, existentially choose, or otherwise change L.
PsiTwoGauge μ Y is inf {t∈ENNReal | Y is measurable, t≠0, t≠∞, exp(Y²/(t.toReal)²) is integrable, and ∫exp(Y²/(t.toReal)²)dμ≤2}.
ENNReal.ofReal r embeds max(r,0) into the extended nonnegative reals.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For any finite (not explicitly nonempty) family of independent, centered real random variables on a probability space, if each X_i has the supplied positive all-λ linear-MGF witness K_i satisfying E exp(λX_i)≤exp(K_i²λ²), and if E=∑_i K_i² is strictly positive, then there exists a real C≥1 such that the sum S=∑_i X_i itself satisfies the exact linear-MGF property with supplied parameter sqrt(E), and its infimum-defined ψ₂ gauge is at most C sqrt(E) after embedding into ENNReal. The K_i are external positive MGF witnesses, not asserted to be exact PsiTwoGauge values or minimal constants. The existential C is inside all binders and hypotheses, so this proposition by itself asserts only a possibly instance-dependent C, not one universal absolute constant shared by all families.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although ι is an arbitrary Fintype and may be empty, the empty case has E=0, contradicting the strict hypothesis 0<E. Hence the implication is vacuously true for the empty type; nonvacuous instances are forced to have at least one index.

The strict energy hypothesis is essential to the stated conclusion because SubGaussianLinearMGF requires its parameter sqrt(E) to be strictly positive. It is stronger in form than nonnegativity, even though positive K_i plus a nonempty finite index set mathematically force it.

The witness C is existentially quantified after the space, measure, family, K-values, independence, and energy hypotheses. Nothing in the quantifier order states that C is universal or independent of those data.

Each K_i is only required to be a positive witness for the specified linear-MGF inequality. There is no equality K_i=PsiTwoGauge μ X_i, no minimality claim, and no relation at all between K_i and the infimum-defined input gauges.
The linear-MGF normalization is exactly exp(K²λ²), with no factor 1/2 or other conventional constant.

PsiTwoGauge is ENNReal-valued and defined as a set infimum. Its definition does not itself assume that an admissible finite nonzero scale exists; the finite upper bound in the conclusion supplies substantive finiteness information for S.
The result concerns real-valued functions on a probability measure space and a finite family only; no infinite or complex-valued family is quantified.
